title: Start
body:
Lupe was at the park hanging out with friends
when one friend shared a secret with him about another person in the group.
What should Lupe do?
[[ A. Lupe must inform the other friends about the situation. |option1]]
[[ B. Lupe must simply ignore the secret. |option2]]
[[ C. Lupe must keep the secret. |option3]]
